instructions: <Replace all text between the quotes/carets with your tide station parameters>
instructions2: <Enter the keyword None for unused parameters>
EMAIL_USERNAME: <email address for the account that issues tide alert messages>
EMAIL_PASSWORD: <email password for the account that issues tide alert messages>
INFLUXDB_LOCAL_URL: <URL of this node's own local InfluxDB 3 Core instance, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8181>
INFLUXDB_LOCAL_TOKEN: <admin token generated with 'influxdb3 create token --admin' on this node>
INFLUXDB_LOCAL_DATABASE: <name of the local InfluxDB 3 Core database, standard: TideData>
INFLUXDB_CLOUD_URL: <InfluxDB Cloud Serverless region host URL for the TideGauge org>
INFLUXDB_CLOUD_TOKEN: <InfluxDB Cloud Serverless API token, scoped to the TideData bucket>
INFLUXDB_CLOUD_ORG: <InfluxDB Cloud Serverless organization name, standard: TideGauge>
INFLUXDB_CLOUD_BUCKET: <InfluxDB Cloud Serverless bucket name, standard: TideData>
INFLUXDB_MEASUREMENT: <InfluxDB measurement name for tide station readings, standard: tide_station>
INFLUXDB_LOCATION: <location tag value used to distinguish this station's readings>
INFLUXDB_SENSOR: <sensor tag value used to distinguish this station's sensor readings>
SMTP_SERVER: <The designation of the SMTP server used to issue tide alert messages>
SMTP_PORT: <The SMTP port number user to issue tide alert messages>
TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID: <The TWILIO account SID for issuing tide alert text messages>
TWILIO_PHONE_SENDER: <The phone number that is authorized to send TWILIO SMS messages>
TWILIO_PHONE_RECIPIENT: <The default TWILIO SMS phone recipient (normally one of the administrators>
